us-fmvss-203.summary: Steering control systems in passenger cars and in multipurpose passenger vehicles, trucks and buses with a GVWR of 4,536 kg or less are regulated to minimize chest, neck and facial injuries to the driver. The steering control must not transmit more than 11,120 N of force to the driver in the S5.1 impact test. The standard does not apply to vehicles that meet the frontal barrier crash requirements (S5.1) of FMVSS 208 by means other than seat belt assemblies, nor to walk-in vans or vehicles without a steering control.

us-fmvss-403.summary: Platform lifts installed in motor vehicles to assist persons with limited mobility are regulated for lifts manufactured on or after April 1, 2005, to prevent injuries and fatalities to passengers and bystanders. Lifts must meet requirements for all lifts (threshold warning, velocity and acceleration limits, platform, edge guards, wheelchair retention, controls, backup operation, interlocks) plus either public-use or private-use requirements, and be labeled 'DOT-Public Use Lift' or 'DOT-Private Use Lift'.
